scope: Only this advisory, for Bun 1.4.4 embedded in putgd-proton-runtime. Does not waive other advisories, other Bun versions or any Grype finding.
assessment: Not reached in put.gd's default launch. putgd-proton-runtime is a stdio JSON client of put.gd: it starts no server, accepts no connections and talks to Proton's API and storage hosts over fetch. No source file of the helper or of its bundled dependencies names http3, node:quic or Bun.serve; the only matches are type declarations (bun-types, @types/bun, @types/node), which bun build does not bundle. put.gd passes no Bun flags, so its fetch uses HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 only. The helper does inherit the resident's environment (ProtonProvider::helperEnvironment removes only PROTON_DRIVE_* and PUTGD_PROTON_*), and Bun 1.4.4 enables its experimental HTTP/3 fetch client when BUN_FEATURE_FLAG_EXPERIMENTAL_HTTP3_CLIENT is set or BUN_OPTIONS carries --experimental-http3-fetch. put.gd, its packages and the supported desktops set neither. Only with one of them set (by the user or by code running as the user) can a request move to HTTP/3, and then only after an eligible Alt-Svc upgrade from a peer the helper accepts over TLS for a Proton API or storage origin; that peer would also have to be malicious. Bun has not confirmed that the client half is exploitable.

method.input: putgd-proton-helper-rebuild.tar.gz from the v26.1124.6905-nightly Proton corresponding source (putgd-proton-corresponding-source.tar.gz parts 1 and 2, downloaded and verified by audit_assets.py)
method.tree: build-source/: 7395 files, 5398 JavaScript or TypeScript (.js .mjs .cjs .ts .mts .cts), 18 top-level node_modules entries, including @protontech/drive-sdk and its nested node_modules
commands: grep -rn -E 'BUN_|experimental-http3|http3' src/ tools/proton/*.ts tools/proton/*.py (application launch path)
results: No file outside the type declaration packages matched.
No match: put.gd sets no Bun variable or flag; the inherited environment is described under inheritedEnvironment.

followUp: Ship Bun 1.4.5: helper rebuild, SOURCES.json rebind, native relink and offline replay proofs (#2005).

inheritedEnvironment.followUp: Clearing these in helperEnvironment changes application bytes; it ships with the Bun 1.4.5 rebuild (#2005).
inheritedEnvironment.optedIn: HTTP/3 off by default. Opted in: an Alt-Svc upgrade (src/http/h3_client/AltSvc.rs) and a malicious TLS-accepted Proton API or storage peer are still required, and client exploitability is unconfirmed.
